**Subject: Application for Software Test Engineer – .Net / C# / MS SQL Server**

Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Software Test Engineer role with the Global Product and Solutions team at Dematic. With extensive experience in end-to-end quality assurance, test automation, and validating complex software integrated with dedicated physical devices, I am excited by the opportunity to contribute to Dematic’s mission of delivering automated warehouse and material handling solutions.

Throughout my career, I have developed deep technical expertise across .NET, C#, and SQL environments. At Avant Mutual, I served as QA Lead during a major platform transition to a cloud-native .NET architecture, where I drove test planning, daily defect triage, and data integrity validation. Additionally, at SmartClinics, I automated regression test suites in C# and transformed complex business specifications into rigorous test scenarios. My technical toolkit also encompasses test automation with Python, automated PR review workflows, and building CI/CD test automation pipelines within Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions.

Dematic’s focus on the intersection of software, hardware, and physical automation strongly aligns with my hands-on background in testing distributed physical systems. At Wpay (Woolworths Group), I architected end-to-end test strategies for distributed terminal hardware solutions—including an unattended EV charging payment initiative—validating message structures, communication protocols, and failure modes prior to deployment. Coupled with my previous work validating transit platform systems at Cubic Transportation Systems (Transport for NSW) and my ISTQB Foundation certification, I bring a methodical approach to writing test plans, conducting code reviews, and collaborating cross-functionally from factory testing through to site commissioning.

I welcome the opportunity to bring my technical skills in .NET, C#, SQL, and test automation to Dematic's engineering team, and I am available to travel to support site testing across the APAC region. Thank you for your time and consideration, and I look forward to discussing how my experience can support your upcoming warehouse automation projects.

Sincerely,  

**Anoop Sinkaran**
